def clipped_surrogate(ratio: float, advantage: float, eps: float = 0.2) -> float:
    """Clipped GRPO/PPO surrogate objective for one sampled completion."""
    unclipped = ratio * advantage
    clipped_ratio = max(1 - eps, min(1 + eps, ratio))
    clipped = clipped_ratio * advantage
    return round(min(unclipped, clipped), 4)

print(clipped_surrogate(1.35, 1.4017))
